## Description
Brief summary of the changes made and the ticket or issue this resolves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated tests

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `pnpm test` runs green across all test files
- [ ] All new public interfaces/seams have test coverage
- [ ] Follows layer boundaries (`app/api` -> `services` -> `data`)
- [ ] RLS policies respected and tested
- [ ] No secrets or API keys in code or git history
